description: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts, the call to applyOutcomeToPosteriors that begins at line 2438 builds its first argument as an object literal containing the properties activity_id, success, failure_mode, cost_usd and tags. Add one more property to that same object literal: metadata, set to the execution trace's metadata so that the information_yield field reaches the posterior update. The receiving type repos/activity-api/src/lib/posterior-update.ts TraceForPosterior now declares metadata?: { information_yield?: string } as an optional property, so passing it is type-safe and passing nothing keeps today's behaviour. Use whichever request-body or validated variable in that function already holds the trace metadata; if the handler validates a body into a variable named validated, the metadata is on that validated object. Do not change any other call site, do not change posterior-update.ts, and do not alter the existing five properties.
